input.question: When did Karl Dönitz get the information that Hitler had committed suicide?
input.ground_truth: Two days gone by and I found the answer myself - I guess nobody will see it, but perhaps someone will someday use the search function. The answer is: Dönitz didn't know it was suicide. He could've guessed so because Hitler had hinted at committing suicide on April 22nd 1945 when Dönitz was with him, but he simply didn't know. *Source: Mario Frank, Der Tod im Führerbunker. Hitlers letzte Tage*
